answer: Proof of Personhood via biometric attestation creates a karst topography of identity, where uniqueness is validated against a rising tide of adversarial bots. By requiring a decentralized lantern of verifiable social graph trust, agents force attackers to bear the prohibitive capital costs of securing authentic hardware attestation per identity, effectively rendering the marginal cost of spawning a fake Sybil node greater than the potential economic gain extracted from the network.
